overview.en: This large South American catfish occurs in the Amazon and Orinoco river basins.
overview.fr: Ce grand poisson-chat sud-américain vit dans les bassins de l’Amazone et de l’Orénoque.

identification.en: It has an elongated body, a flattened head and long barbels; records report up to 150 cm standard length.
identification.fr: Il a un corps allongé, une tête aplatie et de longs barbillons; la longueur standard rapportée atteint 150 cm.

habitat.en: FishBase classifies it as a tropical, freshwater, demersal fish.
habitat.fr: FishBase le classe parmi les poissons tropicaux d’eau douce vivant près du fond.

diet.en: It feeds mainly on small fishes and invertebrates.
diet.fr: Il se nourrit surtout de petits poissons et d’invertébrés.

reproduction.en: The sources used here provide no species-specific account of its spawning or young.
reproduction.fr: Les sources utilisées ici ne décrivent pas la ponte ni les jeunes de cette espèce.

ecology.en: Its large river-basin range spans the Amazon and Orinoco systems; local conservation concerns can differ between basins.
ecology.fr: Son aire couvre les grands réseaux de l’Amazone et de l’Orénoque; les enjeux locaux de conservation peuvent varier entre bassins.

conservation.en: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern from 2020. The USGS profile notes an earlier report of vulnerability in the Orinoco basin.
conservation.fr: FishBase rapporte une évaluation mondiale UICN en Préoccupation mineure datant de 2020. La fiche de l’USGS signale une mention antérieure de vulnérabilité dans le bassin de l’Orénoque.

facts: FishBase gives the Amazon–Orinoco range, tropical freshwater/demersal habitat, maximum standard length of 150 cm and global Least Concern assessment dated 2020; reproduction fields are blank.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Firewood catfish — USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species profile
title.fr: Silure bois de feu — fiche USGS Nonindigenous Aquatic Species

facts: The USGS profile describes the flattened head and barbels, nocturnal habits, fish-and-invertebrate diet, and notes a published Orinoco-basin vulnerability report.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Global status is from the assessment dated 2020; the regional Orinoco vulnerability note is older and is not directly comparable to that global category.
Species-specific reproductive details were not found in the sources consulted.
review_note: Draft only. FishBase and the USGS species profile were cross-checked; taxonomy and regional versus global conservation scope remain explicitly distinguished.
